description: Android activity demonstrating usage of date and time picker dialogs, including dialog creation, state management, and display updates.

classes.name: DateWidgets1
classes.description: Main activity class for date and time widget demonstration, managing dialogs and display updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, initializes date/time variables, and sets button click listeners.

methods.name: setDialogOnClickListener
methods.description: Assigns click listener to buttons to show corresponding dialogs.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns dialog instances based on dialog ID.

methods.name: onPrepareDialog
methods.description: Prepares dialogs before showing, updating their state with current date/time values.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the TextView with the selected date and time.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Formats integers to two-digit strings for display.
